enabled.description: Enable the ConnMan VPN plugin globally.

default_dns.description: Default DNS servers used when VPN is active (space-separated).

connect_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a VPN connection to establish.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous VPN connections allowed.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable IPv6 support for VPN tunnels.

cacert_path.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file (for certificate-based auth). Leave blank if not used.

cert_path.description: Absolute path to client certificate (for certificate-based auth). Leave blank if not used.

key_path.description: Absolute path to client private key (for certificate-based auth). Leave blank if not used.

eap_inner.description: Inner EAP method (e.g., 'md5', 'mschapv2', 'peap', 'ttls'). Only used when `auth_method = 'eap'`.

psk.description: Pre-shared key for IPsec. Warning: avoid hardcoding in production; use secure storage instead.

allowed_gateways.description: List of allowed remote VPN gateways. Each entry can include a host and optional port (e.g., 'vpn.example.com:500').

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the VPN gateway.

port.description: Optional UDP port (e.g., 500 for IKE, 4500 for NAT-T). If omitted, defaults are used.

excluded_subnets.description: List of local subnets (CIDR notation) to exclude from NAT/routing (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

route_priority.description: Priority of routes installed by this VPN. Higher values override lower ones.

auto_reconnect.description: Automatically attempt to reconnect if the VPN connection drops.

reconnect_delay.description: Seconds to wait before trying to reconnect after a failure.

log_file.description: Path to the VPN plugin log file. Empty string disables file logging.

mobike_enabled.description: Enable IKEv2 MOBIKE (Mobility and Multihoming) protocol support.

dpd_enabled.description: Enable Dead Peer Detection (DPD) for IKEv1/IKEv2 to detect orphaned sessions.

dpd_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a DPD response before declaring peer dead.

dns_search_domains.description: Additional DNS search domains to use when VPN is active (space-separated).

dns_backend.description: DNS resolution backend to use: 'systemd-resolved', 'dnsmasq', or 'none' (manual DNS).
